title: Public screenings and the growth of cinema halls
description: The earlier Filmada chronology places the first paid public film screening after 1918 and records cinema halls in provincial capitals from the 1920s. It also notes the first sound-film projection in 1935 and the creation of the private Consortium Cinématographique distribution company in 1936.

sources.note: Recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; dates and institutional details require archival confirmation.
